name: quarter-end-close serves acme-finance
mission_statement: Report results that can be trusted.
rationale: External reporting deadlines and control requirements.
trade_offs: Finance staff overtime at every quarter end.

name: conveyor-maintenance serves acme-plant
rationale: Worn rollers jam the line and tempt people to clear it by hand.

name: production-deployment serves acme-engineering
mission_statement: Customers can rely on the platform.
rationale: Unreviewed changes caused the 2025 outage; change control policy requires recorded approval.
value_created: Fewer failed changes; auditable approvals; risk-proportionate review.
trade_offs: The human gate slows hotfixes; the AI classifier adds model-upgrade risk of its own.

name: lockout-tagout serves acme-plant
rationale: Stored and live energy injure people servicing equipment; the energy control standard makes the procedure mandatory.
value_created: No energy-release injuries; regulatory compliance; machines serviced without guesswork.
trade_offs: Adds about an hour of downtime to every maintenance job and needs a second verifier on every shift.
